items.title: Anthropic Ends Debut Up 17% as Ondo Launches ANTon
items.summary: Ondo announced that ANTon was live for minting and redemption, while Binance scheduled a shift from pre-IPO futures pricing to a stock-linked contract.

items.title: Anthropic’s $81B IPO draws half the net retail buying of SpaceX’s
items.summary: Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most Vanda Research has recorded for a market debut since 2012.

items.title: Here's what's crashing gold and likely weighing on bitcoin too
items.summary: Gold fell to its lowest level since September 2025 on Friday, and the same catalyst driving its decline is likely also weighing on bitcoin.

items.title: CFTC Chair on Hyperliquid and onchain venues, Ripple CLO doubts Elizabeth Warren will set crypto policy, and more
items.summary: In today's newsletter, CFTC Chair Selig outlines how Hyperliquid and other onchain venues could enter the US; Ripple's Alderoty doubts Elizabeth Warren will set US crypto policy; and more.
